_about: Reviewed Sefaria version mapping (Phase 4, items 9-11). Key = exact versionTitle (trimmed, case-insensitive) + language. trust: preferred = may be the default; listed = shown in the version picker, default only when a text has no preferred version in that language; denied = never shown, never sent to the AI. Versions not listed here are 'Unlabelled' and handled by backend/text_trust.py (hidden, never a default). community picks the default: the reader's community first, then general, then the rest. rank breaks ties (lower wins). Edit with care: every entry needs a reason.
